name: octaweave_create_note
description: Create a note. `body` is markdown and is the source of truth; `[[slug]]` inside it links to another note and the server tracks the backlink automatically. `labels` are label NAMES — passing one that does not exist creates it. Omit `slug` to derive it from the title. Returns {id, slug, version}.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.

body.description: Markdown body. Use [[other-note-slug]] to link to sibling notes.

slug.description: Optional URL slug; derived from the title when omitted.

labels.description: Label names. Unknown names are created.
